descriptionAr: Warum es diese Stelle gibt Infinos ist eine der größten Telemedizin-Plattformen für medizinische Abnehmtherapie in Deutschland. Wir machen einen mittleren 7-stelligen Jahresumsatz und haben bis heute kein Investorengeld genommen. Zwei Gründer, ein Team von rund 8 Leuten, tausende Patienten, die wir jeden Monat begleiten. Ich bin Linus, einer der beiden Gründer und habe die Creatives für unsere Ads bisher zum großen Teil selbst gemacht. Das Marketing wächst schneller, als ich es neben allem anderen leisten kann. Deshalb suche ich die Person, die diesen Bereich übernimmt und mit uns ausbaut. Was du machst Den Markt beobachten: was die Konkurrenz in Deutschland und im Ausland schaltet und was im Abnehmmarkt außerhalb der Medizin funktioniert. Daraus testbare Konzepte machen, jeweils mit klarer Hypothese und mehreren Hooks, und davon jede Woche neue an den Start bringen. Creatives selbst bauen, vor allem mit KI: Statics, Animationen und Schnitte aus vorhandenem Material. Drehs organisieren, mit uns Gründern, unserem Team und UGC-Creator, von Briefing und Skript bis zur Abnahme. Auswerten, was läuft und daraus die nächste Runde ableiten. Später dazu: unseren Newsletter und Shortform-Content für TikTok und Reels. Deine ersten 90 Tage Woche 1: deine erste eigene Ad ist live. Monat 1: Marktbeobachtung und Ideenplanung laufen über dich und jede Woche gehen neue Tests von dir raus. Monat 3: du gibst deine Ads selbst frei, kennst die Regeln für Werbung im Gesundheitsbereich sicher und hast einen Plan, wie wir organisch auf Shortform wachsen. Wen wir suchen Du hast schon Creatives für Paid Social gebaut, die gelaufen sind und weißt, warum sie funktioniert haben. Wie groß das Budget dahinter war, ist zweitrangig. Du baust selbst, statt nur zu briefen, und arbeitest dafür täglich mit KI-Tools für Bild, Video, Stimme und Text. Du schreibst gute deutsche Hooks und Skripte. Sehr gute deutsche Sprachkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind deshalb Voraussetzung. Du verstehst, warum jemand mit Übergewicht nach Hilfe sucht und warum er sie dann oft doch nicht annimmt und du schreibst darüber ohne Herablassung. Du hast Lust, dich in die Regeln für Werbung im Gesundheitsbereich einzuarbeiten. Was wir zeigen dürfen und was nicht, bringen wir dir bei. Du willst die Stelle in Vollzeit machen und nicht nebenbei. Hilfreich, aber nicht nötig: Erfahrung in Health, Fitness oder Ernährung oder mit anderer regulierter Werbung, ein Netzwerk an UGC-Creator, Videoschnitt. Wenn du aus dem Performance-Marketing kommst und kreativer arbeiten willst, bewirb dich trotzdem. Was wir bieten €48.000–60.000 Fixgehalt, je nach Erfahrung. Virtuelle Unternehmensanteile aus unserem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungspool (VSOP). Die Höhe besprechen wir im ersten Gespräch. KI-Tooling ohne Budgetgrenze. Remote mit regelmäßigen Teamtreffen vor Ort und freier Zeiteinteilung, solange die Arbeit stimmt. Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit beiden Gründern und ehrliches Feedback in beide Richtungen. 30 Tage Urlaub. So bewirbst du dich Kein Anschreiben. Im Bewerbungsformular hier auf join fragen wir dich zwei Dinge: warum du die richtige Person für diese Rolle bist, mit deiner Erfahrung und dem, was du bisher erreicht hast, gern mit Zahlen. Und welche unserer Ads aus der Meta Ad Library du anders machen würdest, mit einem Satz, wie. Wir antworten innerhalb von 3 Tagen. Dann: 30 Minuten Videocall mit Jan und mir. Wir erzählen, wie wir arbeiten und warum es die Stelle gibt. Du erzählst uns, was du bisher gemacht hast und was du suchst. Eine Probeaufgabe von etwa 4 bis 5 Stunden: Markt anschauen, ein Testpaket entwickeln und ein Creative fertig bauen. 30 Minuten, in denen du uns die Probeaufgabe vorstellst und wir über die Erwartungen beider Seiten sprechen. Angebot, schriftlich. Vom ersten Gespräch bis hierhin brauchen wir in der Regel zwei bis drei Wochen. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

descriptionAr: Our project for you: moebel.de is Europe's leading price comparison site for furniture and home furnishings. Our family of portals operates in nine European countries, including Germany, France, Spain, the Netherlands, Italy and Poland. Now we are getting started in earnest in the UK: living24.uk is live – our price comparison site for furniture, home furnishings, garden and décor, as well as white goods and home electronics. The launch is done, the technology works. What decides the pace now are the retailers: the more relevant shops list their ranges on living24.uk, the stronger the comparison for users – and the faster the portal grows. This is not selling from a tidy list of existing accounts. You take on a freshly launched market and build the partner portfolio that living24.uk runs on. Whoever delivers over the next few months will shape what moebel.de looks like in the UK. That is why we are looking for you as Senior Sales Manager UK. Your future Tasks Building the market: you build living24.uk's partner portfolio – from first contact through pitch and negotiation to the signed contract. Your targets are UK online retailers in furniture, home furnishings, garden, décor, white goods, home electronics and small appliances. Selling a performance model: you show retailers how living24.uk pays off as an additional channel – through cost per click, visibility, feed quality and cost-of-sale. Seeing partners through to go-live: product feed, tracking, range checks – together with the team in Hamburg. After go-live our Relationship Management team takes over day-to-day care, so you can focus on winning new partners. Presence in the market: retailer visits, trade fairs and industry events across the UK. In a young market, trust is built face to face. Ear to the ground: competition, price levels, what UK retailers expect, seasonality – what you learn in the field feeds into product, pricing and priorities. Your Strenghts Several years of sales experience in UK e-commerce, ideally with a price comparison site, marketplace, affiliate network or performance marketing provider A solid network of UK retailers in our categories that you can put to work from day one Command of the performance model: CPC, CPO, affiliate, product feeds, ROAS and cost-of-sale are selling points for you, not buzzwords A hunter's mindset: you keep your own pipeline full, cold outreach included, and get deals over the line An appetite for building: pace and open questions appeal to you more than a field that has already been ploughed Working from the numbers, with clean CRM records as the basis for how you steer Willingness to travel across the UK and to regular meetings in Hamburg Fluent English at negotiation level – German is a plus, not a requirement Our Benefits Your day is yours to shape Work when you are most productive. Early bird or night owl: you set your hours flexibly, in agreement with your team. Working from another European country for a while? No problem. Your laptop is your workplace. Our culture is one of a kind Here everyone sits on the same couch, regardless of title or role. We live team spirit online and in person – gaming nights, workouts, film evenings and team events. Four times a year we meet for Company Week Working together in the office, pushing projects forward, pizza evenings and a party to finish. In the heart of Hamburg When you are in Hamburg, our office is waiting for you – centrally located between the main station, Mönckebergstraße and the Binnenalster lake. Perfect for lunch dates, a break by the Alster or a stroll after work. We are looking forward to receiving your application! Please send your application exclusively through our online application form – it goes straight to our recruiting team. You are welcome to submit your CV in English or German, ideally with your salary expectations and earliest possible start date. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

descriptionAr: Unser Projekt für dich: moebel.de ist Europas führender Preisvergleich für Möbel und Einrichtung. Mit unserer Portalfamilie sind wir in neun europäischen Ländern aktiv, darunter Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien, die Niederlande und Italien. Jetzt legen wir in Polen richtig los: mobi24.pl ist live – unser Preisvergleich für Möbel, Einrichtung, Garten und Dekoration sowie Weiße Ware und Haushaltselektronik. Der Launch ist geschafft, die Technik läuft. Über das Tempo entscheiden jetzt die Händler: Je mehr relevante Shops mit ihren Sortimenten auf mobi24.pl vertreten sind, desto stärker der Vergleich für die Nutzer und desto schneller wächst das Portal. Das ist kein Vertrieb aus einer gepflegten Bestandsliste. Du übernimmst einen frisch gestarteten Markt und baust das Partnerportfolio auf, das mobi24.pl trägt. Wer hier in den nächsten Monaten liefert, prägt, wie moebel.de in Polen aussieht. Dafür suchen wir dich als Senior Sales Manager Polen (m/w/d). Deine zukünftigen Aufgaben Marktaufbau: Du baust das Partnerportfolio von mobi24.pl auf – vom Erstkontakt über Pitch und Verhandlung bis zum Vertrag. Zielgruppe sind polnische Online-Händler aus Möbel, Einrichtung, Garten, Dekoration, Weiße Ware, Haushaltselektronik und Elektrokleingeräte. Performance-Modell verkaufen: Du erklärst Händlern, wie sich mobi24.pl als zusätzlicher Kanal rechnet – über Klickpreise, Sichtbarkeit, Feed-Qualität und Kosten-Umsatz-Relation. Bis zum Livegang begleiten: Produktdatenfeed, Tracking, Sortimentsprüfung – gemeinsam mit dem Team in Hamburg. Danach übernimmt unser Relationship Management die laufende Betreuung, du konzentrierst dich auf neue Partner. Präsenz im Markt: Händlerbesuche, Messen und Branchenevents innerhalb Polens. In einem jungen Markt entsteht Vertrauen im persönlichen Gespräch. Ohr im Markt: Wettbewerb, Preisniveau, Erwartungen polnische Händler, Saisonalitäten – deine Erkenntnisse fließen in Produkt, Pricing und Priorisierung ein. Deine Stärken Mehrjährige Vertriebserfahrung im polnische E-Commerce, idealerweise bei Preisvergleich, Marktplatz, Affiliate-Netzwerk oder Performance-Marketing-Anbieter Ein belastbares Netzwerk zu polnische Händlern aus unseren Kategorien, das du ab Tag eins nutzt Sicherheit im Performance-Modell: CPC, CPO, Affiliate, Produktdatenfeeds, ROAS und KUR sind für dich Argumente, keine Buzzwords Hunter-Mentalität: Du hältst deine Pipeline eigenständig voll, auch per Kaltakquise, und bringst Abschlüsse über die Linie Lust auf Aufbauarbeit: Tempo und offene Fragen reizen dich mehr als ein fertig bestelltes Feld Zahlenbasiertes Arbeiten und saubere CRM-Pflege als Grundlage deiner Steuerung Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Polens und für regelmäßige Termine in Hamburg Polnisch verhandlungssicher, Englisch sicher im Arbeitsalltag – Deutsch ist ein Plus, keine Voraussetzung Unser Angebot Dein Tagesablauf gehört dir Arbeite dann, wenn du am produktivsten bist. Ob Früh- oder Spätaufsteher: Bei uns passt du deine Arbeitszeiten flexibel an – in enger Abstimmung mit deinem Team. Zeitweise Arbeiten aus dem europäischen Ausland? Kein Problem. Dein Laptop ist dein Arbeitsplatz. Unsere Kultur ist einmalig Hier sitzen alle auf derselben Couch – unabhängig von Titel oder Rolle. Teamspirit leben wir digital und vor Ort, z. B. bei Gaming Nights, Workouts, Filmabenden oder Teamevents. Viermal im Jahr treffen wir uns zur Company Week Gemeinsam im Büro arbeiten, Projekte pushen, Pizzabende genießen und mit einer Party abschließen. Mitten in Hamburg Bei deinen Aufenthalten in Hamburg erwartet dich unser Büro zentral zwischen Hauptbahnhof, Mönckebergstraße und Binnenalster – perfekt für Lunch-Dates, Pausen an der Alster oder einen Feierabendbummel. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Bitte richte Deine Bewerbungsunterlagen ausschließlich mithilfe unseres Online-Bewerbungsformulars direkt an unser Recruiting Team. Deinen Lebenslauf kannst du gern auf Polnisch, Englisch oder Deutsch einreichen – idealerweise mit Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestmöglichem Starttermin. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

descriptionAr: Wir suchen jemanden, der wirklich mitbaut. Lippe Personal ist seit 2017 auf einen Markt spezialisiert, der gerade unter Druck steht: Arztpraxen, Zahnarztpraxen, Physiotherapeuten und Apotheken in Deutschland finden kaum noch qualifiziertes Personal. Der Fachkräftemangel ist real, die Digitalisierung in diesem Bereich steckt noch in den Kinderschuhen, und die Lösungen, die es heute gibt, sind nicht für die Nutzer gebaut, die sie eigentlich brauchen. Das wollen wir ändern. Wir bauen gerade eine digitale Plattform auf, die den medizinischen Arbeitsmarkt im DACH-Raum neu strukturiert. Datengetrieben, mobil-first, mit einem klaren Fokus auf echten Nutzen fuer Praxen und Bewerber. Das Projekt steckt noch in der Aufbauphase, und genau das ist der Punkt: Du kommst dazu, bevor die grossen Entscheidungen gefallen sind. Was du bei uns machen wirst: Du entwickelst und pflegst eine skalierbare Web-Plattform auf Basis von Next.js und Django. Du baust die Datenbankstruktur in PostgreSQL und Supabase mit auf. Du setzt programmatische SEO-Seiten fuer Tausende Standorte und Fachrichtungen um. Du entwickelst mobile-first Bewerbungs- und Recruiting-Flows, die sich in unter 60 Sekunden abschliessen lassen. Du arbeitest an automatisierten Datenpipelines und der Scraping-Infrastruktur. Du bist direkt im Austausch mit dem Gruender, kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen. Das ist keine Stelle, bei der du Tickets abarbeitest und auf Reviews wartest. Du bekommst echte Verantwortung, von Anfang an. Unser Tech-Stack: Frontend: Next.js (React), App Router, SSG/ISR Backend: Python / Django, REST API Datenbank: PostgreSQL und Supabase Deployment: Vercel und Cloud-Infrastruktur Analytics: PostHog Daten: Eigene Scraper-Architektur, offizielle APIs Das bringst du mit: Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der Fullstack-Webentwicklung Gute Kenntnisse in Next.js / React und Python / Django oder einem vergleichbaren Python-Backend Erfahrung mit PostgreSQL und relationalen Datenbankmodellen Ein Verständnis für SEO-technische Anforderungen (SSG, Sitemap, Core Web Vitals) Mobile-first Denken, du weisst, dass die meisten Bewerber vom Smartphone kommen Selbststaendiges, eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten Gutes Deutsch, unser Markt ist DACH Und wenn du noch dazu Erfahrung mit Supabase, Vercel oder Web-Scraping mitbringst, Marktplaetze oder SaaS-Produkte aus der Naeher kennst oder einfach Lust hast, in einem kleinen Team wirklich etwas zu bewegen, dann passt das gut. descriptionAr: Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com . We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by two leading VCs (TQ Ventures & Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond. Every day, millions of travelers book buses, trains, ferries and transfers through platforms they know, and many of those bookings run on Distribusion. We connect hundreds of carriers with the world’s leading travel retailers, making ground transport as easy to book as a flight. We’re looking for ambitious graduates who want real responsibility from day one. As part of our Graduate Program, you’ll join one of our core teams as an Analyst or Engineer, work on live products used across the globe, and learn alongside people who are building the infrastructure of ground travel. Workplace: Berlin & Remote or willing to relocate to Berlin. Where you could make your mark Product: Analyst roles Search Engine & Booking Platform: Build the core engine that returns fast, scalable search results and handles thousands of booking requests per second. Supply & Integrations: Connect hundreds of external carrier APIs and help build robust, fault‑tolerant infrastructure that keeps bookings flowing. E‑commerce: Shape the booking engines, payment flows and user journeys that let travelers search, book, pay for and manage trips. Your work directly moves conversion and retention for a global audience across many markets, currencies and languages. Connectivity: Build enterprise‑grade integrations with external systems like Salesforce, SAP, CRMs and government authorities, with a strong focus on automation and innovation. Tech: Engineer roles Demand Engineering: Work on the heart of our platform: the search and booking engine that lets the world’s biggest travel retailers sell bus and rail tickets through a single API, and the schedule system behind hundreds of thousands of daily departures used by hundreds of operators. Build high‑throughput microservices, help modernize our core search engine, and shape the product, not just the code. Content Engineering: Build the pipelines that keep global travel data accurate and up to date. Automate how we ingest stations, prices and schedule changes in real time, and apply AI to keep millions of data points reliable at scale. Partnerships roles Regional Partnerships: Work hands‑on with bus, rail, ferry and transfer operators and leading travel retailers in your region, guiding them from first integration to growing their bookings across our global network. Corporate Partnerships: Bring ground transport into business travel by working with travel management companies, corporate travel agencies and booking tools, from technical onboarding to growing the partnership. Performance & Growth: Dig into partner data, spot opportunities, and build the processes and automation that help us scale. Who you are: STEM or tech-related academic background - You’re a recent (or soon-to-be) graduate in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, Business/Information Systems, or a similar field. Analytical mindset & problem-solving - You love digging into complex problems, understanding how things work, and turning ambiguity into clear, structured solutions. Technical curiosity: You have a basic understanding of APIs, systems or digital products (through studies, internships or projects), and you’re excited to build with AI, whether that’s experimenting with new tools, prototyping ideas or putting AI to work on real problems in a high‑scale environment. Strong communication - You can explain ideas clearly, whether talking to engineers, product managers, or business teams — and you enjoy bridging technical and non-technical worlds. Collaborative & cross-functional - You like working with diverse teams and feel comfortable contributing to group projects, Agile teamwork, and shared problem-solving. Fast learner & adaptable - You thrive in dynamic environments, pick up new tools and concepts quickly, and stay resilient when things change or are not fully defined. Ownership & ambition - You’re eager to take responsibility early, bring ideas to the table, and help shape processes that improve how products get delivered. What you can expect: Global reach & real-world impact - You help build software that enables travel for millions of people globally; your work supports real journeys across countries and continents, and makes transportation more accessible. Cutting-edge tech in a high‑scale environment - From microservices and real-time search to AI-based content automation and cloud infrastructure, you’ll gain hands-on experience with many modern technologies and complex systems. Fast growth & startup energy - Distribusion is rapidly expanding globally (70+ countries, hundreds of carriers/retailers), backed by strong funding — you’ll have the opportunity to take real ownership early, learn fast, and grow with the company. Variety: you can pick what excites you - Whether you like backend APIs, front‑end booking flows, data & analytics or product. There are many teams and disciplines where you can start, explore and specialise. Meaningful mission — mobility & sustainability - By enabling efficient ground transportation (bus, rail, ferry) globally, Distribusion contributes to more sustainable travel alternatives to private cars or flights. Global partnerships & industry exposure - You’ll collaborate with some of the biggest names in travel technology and national transportation, working directly with partners like Booking.co

descriptionAr: Note: The listed salary range is based on the salary range for the Netherlands. Salary ranges may vary by location. About the Role As a Senior Quality Engineer – Tellent Intelligence (AI) , you'll own and grow the quality of the AI-powered experiences built by our Tellent Intelligence team alongside our existing QE team. You'll help shape how we test applications powered by large language models (LLMs) and AI agents, ensuring they are reliable, safe, and deliver high-quality experiences for our customers. You'll expand our end-to-end test coverage in Playwright and help build robust approaches for validating AI-powered systems, where quality extends beyond functional correctness. This is a hands-on, collaborative role with genuine ownership, direct impact on product development, and the opportunity to shape how we test AI at Tellent. Your 12-Month Journey During your first 3 months: You'll get to know our Tellent Intelligence domain, engineering practices, AI-powered features, and quality standards. You'll learn our testing framework and development workflow while contributing to automated, exploratory, and AI-focused testing. Within 6 months: You'll take ownership of quality across key AI-powered features, expand our Playwright test coverage, and work closely with engineers to validate AI behaviour, prompts, and model-driven functionality throughout development. After 1 year: You'll be a trusted quality partner within the Tellent Intelligence team, driving improvements to our AI testing strategy, strengthening our automation framework, and helping shape how we build reliable, safe, and responsible AI experiences across Tellent. What You'll Be Doing Work closely with fellow Quality Engineers to bring our test automation strategy to life across the Tellent Intelligence domain, taking shared ownership and continuously improving it as our platform evolves. Partner with developers, AI engineers, and fellow QEs to embed quality early in the development process, sharing knowledge and shaping testing practices collaboratively. Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and automated test suites across frontend, backend, and AI-powered functionality. Develop into a product domain expert, using your understanding to identify risks early and guide quality decisions across the Tellent Intelligence domain. Design and execute testing strategies for AI-powered features, validating not only functional correctness but also the quality, relevance, consistency, and safety of AI-generated outputs. Develop approaches for testing non-deterministic systems by creating evaluation datasets, defining quality benchmarks, and identifying hallucinations, bias, regressions, and prompt-related issues as models and prompts evolve. Partner with engineers to validate prompt changes, AI agent behaviour, and safety guardrails, ensuring our AI behaves reliably and responsibly before reaching customers. Continuously improve how we evaluate AI quality by helping establish best practices, quality metrics, and testing frameworks for LLM-powered applications. What You Bring Strong QA experience: Several years of hands-on quality engineering, with senior-level ownership of testing for complex web applications. AI quality mindset: Experience testing AI-powered applications, LLM-based products, conversational AI, or machine learning systems is a strong plus. If you haven't worked directly with AI before, you're excited to learn and apply quality engineering principles to this rapidly evolving space. E2E automation: Experience building and maintaining end-to-end test suites in Playwright. API & backend testing skills: Experience testing APIs and backend services. Balance of product and technical thinking: Equally at home discussing product behaviour and digging into technical detail. Understanding of AI testing challenges: Familiarity with concepts such as prompt engineering, AI agents, hallucinations, model bias, evaluation datasets, and AI safety principles is a plus. Analytical mindset: Comfortable defining quality expectations for systems where outputs may vary while still delivering a great user experience. Communication: Fluent English for daily collaboration. Polish is a plus. What We Offer Hybrid or remote working setup across Amsterdam, the Cologne area, or Poland A chance to shape one of the most ambitious scale-ups in Europe and lead a company-defining tech transition. Work in a diverse, multicultural, and remote-friendly team. €1,500 annual training budget + 2 dedicated learning days Pension plan, travel reimbursement, and wellness perks. 28 paid holiday days + 2 additional days to relax. Work from anywhere for 4 weeks/year. Apple MacBook and top-tier tooling. €200 home office budget. Please note: Benefits may differ based on your employment location. About Tellent Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System ( Tellent Recruitee ), an intuitive HRIS ( Tellent HR ), and powerful Performance Management software ( Tellent Grow ). With 250+ team members globally, 7,000+ customers in 100+ countries, and a growing ecosystem of 500+ partners, we help organizations attract, grow, and retain top talent — and we’re just getting started. AI in our recruitment process We use our internally developed AI tools to help streamline our recruitment process. However, technology never makes a decision. Every candidate is personally reviewed by our team. Your journey with us is guided by people, supported by tech. Curious about how it works? Read our AI Statement , check our Privacy Policy , or chat with us at If you require accommodations or support during the recruitment process, please let us know — we’re happy to help. descriptionAr: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend  The Opportunity:  Grafana is an open-source observability product and a platform that teams and plugin developers build on. The Frontend group shapes its user experience (from dashboards and visualisation to navigation, search and sharing) and the foundations that support engineering teams and community contributors across the Grafana ecosystem. As Senior Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the Frontend Platform and Navigation squads, owning their performance, delivery and customer outcomes. Frontend Platform enables teams to build reliable, high-quality experiences; Navigation helps users find and organise resources and move confidently through Grafana. You’ll develop senior engineers, partner with Product and Design, and improve how teams work, including through AI and automation. We use Cloud-first rollout and experimentation to learn quickly, bringing relevant improvements to OSS and Enterprise. AI Notice: We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. As the first and only engineer in this specialized domain, the incoming candidate will take an original product vision and turn it into a robust, high-performance system—holding the entire architecture and the smallest details simultaneously. The operational environment is primarily asynchronous, highly independent, and built for top-tier developers who can scale infrastructure from zero to massive daily trading volumes while maintaining absolute reliability. Requirements Platform Ownership: Own the core platform, including the data layer, rewards engine, notifications, the API surface, and overall system reliability. Data Harmonization: Aggregate and unify conflicting data providers (such as Zerion, CoinGecko, Mobula, Alchemy, and Hyperliquid) into a single, cohesive source of truth. High-Performance Data Delivery: Serve heavy data rapidly by implementing resilient caching mechanisms that survive traffic stampedes and fan-out structures that hold under pressure. Cross-Chain Abstraction: Design architecture that makes a single USDC balance across multiple chains entirely invisible and seamless to the end user. Peak Performance & Reliability: Maintain absolute uptime during peak market volatility; ensure the application never lags or crashes when it matters most, guaranteeing users can always close positions. Requirements Proven track record of engineering resilience, including keeping a high-stakes system alive through massive traffic spikes and determining graceful degradation strategies in advance. Extensive experience building financial rewards and accounting systems that withstand retries, prioritizing idempotency, replay safety, and precise lot tracking. Deep understanding of end-to-end latency budgets (from a user's tap to screen rendering). Advanced database optimization skills, capable of resolving bottlenecks directly within PostgreSQL rather than relying on secondary databases. Strong proficiency in Rust development. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote environment across North American or European timezones. Benefits Competitive Compensation: Top-market base salary paired with significant equity upside. descriptionAr: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. As a Manager, Customer Success , you will lead a North America-based team that helps customers realize value from GitLab through strong adoption, measurable outcomes, and trusted partnership. You will partner closely with both executive sponsors and day-to-day end users/practitioners to drive adoption and measurable outcomes. Reporting to the Director of Customer Success, , you will coach Customer Success Managers and Customer Success Architects to support account health across onboarding, adoption stages, executive business reviews, and renewals, while also improving how the team works. This is a people leadership role with broad scope: you will develop talent, strengthen customer relationships, and partner across Sales, Product, Engineering, and other teams so customers are supported through growth, change, and escalation. What you'll do Lead a team of Customer Success Managers and Customer Success Architects focused on customer adoption, account health, customer satisfaction, and advocacy. Coach team members through regular feedback, development support, and career growth conversations to strengthen knowledge, communication, and execution. Partner with the Director of Customer Success to define team goals, clarify responsibilities, and align priorities with company direction. Manage resource assignments, staffing levels, and hiring activity to support team coverage and customer needs. Develop senior-level relationships with customers and support the team in building trusted advisor partnerships. Collaborate with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Professional Services, and other internal teams to create a consistent customer experience. Support customers during escalations by working with other leaders to coordinate clear, effective responses. Improve the processes and tools used by the team and oversee initiatives tied to objectives and key results. What you'll bring Experience leading customer-facing teams in software, technology, consulting, sales, or customer success environments. Ability to guide teams that drive software adoption and manage customer relationships across onboarding, adoption, business reviews, and renewals. Knowledge of software development lifecycle practices, related tools, and agile or DevOps ways of working. Familiarity with cloud or container technologies such as Kubernetes and Docker, application security concepts such as static application security testing (SAST) and dynamic application security testing (DAST), or cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Microsoft Azure. Skill in translating strategy into clear initiatives, coordinating execution, and tracking delivery across competing priorities. Capability to lead distributed teams across regions, cultures, and lines of business, while working effectively with senior executives and external stakeholders. Willingness to travel occasionally for customer meetings and team events, as needed. Strength in communication, coaching, feedback, delegation, planning, and process improvement. Warmth and care in your leadership approach—able to coach with empathy and build trust on a human level. Interest in candidates with transferable experience who can connect technical concepts to business value and collaborate well across functions. About the team On the Customer Success team, we are accountable for customer adoption, measurable outcomes, customer satisfaction, and building customer advocacy across GitLab. We also act as a key connection point between customers and the broader GitLab ecosystem, helping streamline collaboration with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Professional Services, and other partners. In this role, you will manage a team in North America while collaborating asynchronously with stakeholders across regions, with a focus on helping customers succeed at scale and improving how the organization supports them. descriptionAr: ClickHouse Cloud, the fully managed version of the open source ClickHouse database, is available on AWS, GCP, and Azure. Customers can purchase directly from ClickHouse or through the cloud marketplaces. Billing is how every ClickHouse product reaches customers and shows up in our financials. As we add new products and new ways to buy, we are investing in our billing platform to scale with them. As Senior Product Manager for Billing and Marketplaces, you will own a key area of that work and report to the Director of Product Management, Billing and Marketplaces. You Will: Own the roadmap, execution, and launches for a key area of billing or marketplaces (for example metering and pricing, prepaid commit, or a cloud marketplace), working alongside engineering leads, Finance, and Sales Ops. Scope features with engineering, turn them into a clear near-term roadmap, and track them through to launch. Improve our prepaid commit capabilities, including customer-specific rate cards, contract changes and rollovers, customer-facing balance visibility, and spend alerts. Drive our cloud marketplace integrations across AWS, GCP, and Azure, including private offers, usage reporting, and subscription linking. Improve payment and collections flows, including dunning and delinquency handling, so customers are billed accurately and service is not interrupted by avoidable billing issues. Lead billing launches for new products and pricing models in partnership with Product Marketing, Sales, and Support. Serve as a subject matter expert on how customers are billed across the company. You Bring: 7+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years owning billing, metering, payments, or commercial platforms for a cloud or usage-based product. Solid understanding of usage-based pricing, prepaid credits, and committed spend contracts, and how they translate into systems, invoices, and revenue. Hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure marketplaces, including private offers, co-sell, and metering APIs. Familiarity with payments across card, invoice, and marketplace channels, including dunning and delinquency flows. Working knowledge of order-to-cash, including invoicing, tax, multi-currency, and revenue recognition. Experience with third-party billing and payment platforms, such as Stripe or a usage-based billing vendor. A track record of independently leading complex projects across engineering, Finance, and go-to-market teams, from scoping through launch. Strong written and verbal communication, including presenting trade-offs to product and engineering leadership and explaining billing concepts to non-technical audiences. Bonus Points: Experience at an infrastructure, database, or developer platform company. Comfortable going deep with engineers on event-driven architectures, data pipelines, and idempotency, and fluent enough in SQL to analyze billing data yourself. Perks Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries. Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare. Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options. Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries. A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee. Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites. Culture - We All Shape It As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture. Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here . Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse. Equal Opportunity & Privacy ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. descriptionAr: ClickHouse Cloud, the fully managed version of the open source ClickHouse database, is available on AWS, GCP, and Azure. Customers can purchase directly from ClickHouse or through the cloud marketplaces. Billing is how every ClickHouse product reaches customers and shows up in our financials. As we add new products and new ways to buy, we are investing in our billing platform to scale with them. As Principal Product Manager for Billing and Marketplaces, you will lead that work and report to the Director of Product Management, Billing and Marketplaces. What you will do: Own the multi-year vision, strategy, and roadmap for billing, from usage metering through invoicing, payments, and revenue recognition, working alongside the product managers and engineering leads of our metering and pricing, billing platform, and payments teams. Evolve our metering and pricing foundation into a single metrics pipeline that new products can reuse, where the same metric can be priced differently by product and tier, and only net-new metrics need code changes. Evolve our prepaid commit capabilities, with flexibility for customer-specific rate cards or metric-level discounts, contract changes and rollovers, and customer-facing balance visibility and spend alerts. Own our cloud marketplace strategy and integrations across AWS, GCP, and Azure, including private offers, usage reporting, and subscription linking. Lead the evaluation of billing architecture, from build versus buy decisions and POCs through migration plans and a clear recommendation to senior leadership. Give Finance, Data, and Sales Ops systems they can trust, including ERP and revenue recognition sync, period close, audit controls, and SOX and SOC 2 readiness. Partner with product teams, Product Marketing, Sales, and Support to launch billing for new products and pricing models, and serve as the company's subject matter expert on how customers are billed. Mentor other product managers and help build the team. About You: 10+ years of product management experience, including 5+ years owning billing, metering, payments, or commercial platforms for a cloud or usage-based product. Deep expertise in usage-based pricing, prepaid credits, and committed spend contracts, and in how they translate into systems, invoices, and revenue. descriptionAr: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role As an Strategic Account Executive , you’ll help expand GitLab’s presence across the Public Sector in Brazil by building trusted relationships with senior leaders at large organizations and guiding them through complex platform decisions. You’ll use a consultative sales approach to connect customer business needs with our AI-powered DevSecOps platform, helping teams improve developer productivity, reduce security and compliance risk, and move software delivery forward with more confidence. In this role, you’ll support strategic accounts across the full customer journey, from early conversations through adoption, while helping us position GitLab as a leading DevSecOps partner in the Brazilian market. You’ll work across pre-sales, post-sales, partner, marketing, and support teams, and we’ll rely on you to bring strong account leadership, customer outcomes, and clear communication in English and Portuguese . Over your first year, your impact will come from building account plans for large organizations, developing new opportunities, and helping customers successfully adopt GitLab in ways that align to their business goals. What you’ll do Lead strategic account activity for prospects and customers across the Public Sector in Brazil, providing direction throughout pre-sales and post-sales engagements. Develop opportunities within Public Sector accounts through prospecting, relationship building, and a consultative understanding of customer business needs. Create account plans and customer proposals that clearly connect GitLab capabilities to organizational priorities and transformation goals. Coordinate with pre-sales, post-sales, and support teams to support successful product rollout and customer adoption. Generate qualified pipeline in partnership with strategic channel partners and support new customer development efforts. Contribute customer feedback and product ideas to GitLab’s public issue tracker to represent the voice of the customer. Prepare activity and forecast reports, and help analyze wins and losses to improve future sales execution. Collaborate with marketing, account teams, product managers, and technical teams to share lessons learned and communicate customer needs clearly. What you’ll bring 5+ years experience selling into large organizations and navigating complex Public Sector sales cycles with multiple stakeholders. Ability to build and manage executive-level customer relationships with a high degree of ownership and follow-through. Skill in consultative selling, including shaping proposals, presentations, and formal quotes around customer business needs. Strength in negotiation, presentation, and closing conversations in a clear and effective way. Comfort working independently on complex projects while coordinating with cross-functional teams. Fluency in English and Portuguese for customer-facing and internal communication. Familiarity with GitLab or related tools, including Git, software development tools, application lifecycle management, or security and application security tools. Alignment with GitLab’s values, with openness to transferable experience from adjacent technical or software environments. About the team The team focuses on growing GitLab’s Public Sector business in Brazil by helping organizations adopt a single platform for software delivery, security, and collaboration. This role works closely with cross-functional partners across sales, solutions, support, marketing, and product, and contributes to an asynchronous, distributed way of working that values transparency, accountability, and shared customer insight. The team’s work sits at the intersection of strategic growth and customer transformation, with a focus on helping Public Sector organizations evaluate, adopt, and expand their use of GitLab across complex environments. descriptionAr: About the Team Dots is building personal AI agents that help people make progress on their goals, including when they are away from ChatGPT. These agents can learn preferences, maintain context, work across applications, and use cloud computers to carry out tasks. Our team brings together product engineering, design, and research to turn frontier model capabilities into useful everyday experiences. We are defining how people delegate work, understand what an agent is doing, and stay in control. Engineers help shape both the product and the systems behind it, from early prototypes through launch and iteration. About the Role We are looking for Senior and Staff Full Stack Software Engineers to build Dots product experiences from the interface through the services that power them. You will help define how people delegate tasks to personal agents, follow their progress, and collaborate with them over time. This role combines hands-on product development with the systems work needed to make persistent, asynchronous agent experiences reliable. In this role, you will: Build and launch features across web interfaces, APIs, backend services, and data models. Create workflows for task creation, progress updates, agent feedback, and results that remain coherent across sessions and devices. Translate emerging model capabilities into product prototypes with research, product, and design partners. Design clear interfaces between product surfaces and agent execution systems. Improve performance and reliability across the stack, including user-facing latency and recovery from partial failures. Own projects from early exploration through architecture, implementation, launch, and iteration based on user feedback. Help establish technical direction, testing practices, and observability as the product grows. You might thrive in this role if you: Have significant experience building and shipping products across frontend and backend systems. Can move comfortably between user interfaces, service design, APIs, and data modeling. Bring strong product instincts and care about making complex capabilities understandable to users. Have taken ambiguous ideas from concept to production and made practical tradeoffs between iteration speed and long-term maintainability. Understand asynchronous workflows and can reason about state, consistency, and failure across system boundaries. Collaborate effectively with design, product, research, and engineering partners. Have owned complex engineering projects and helped other engineers make sound technical decisions. Experience launching new consumer products, building agent or workflow applications, or working in small teams with broad engineering ownership is especially relevant. Prior experience with AI or machine learning is helpful, but not required. We welcome experienced engineers who want to bring strong product and engineering judgment to a new category of software. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. descriptionAr: About the Team Safety Systems manages the complete lifecycle of safety efforts for OpenAI’s frontier models, ensuring our models are deployed responsibly and have a positive impact on society. Our work spans diverse research and engineering initiatives—from system-level safeguards and model training to evaluation and red-teaming—all aimed at mitigating misuse, misalignment, and maintaining our high bar for safety. We lead OpenAI's commitment to developing and deploying safe Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), fostering a culture of trust, responsibility, and transparency. descriptionAr: About the Role As Head of First Party Chip Finance, you will be the finance leader for OpenAI’s custom silicon efforts. You will partner with teams across chip design, engineering, infrastructure, supply chain, and finance to turn technical roadmaps into sound investment decisions and financially disciplined execution. This role spans the full chip development lifecycle: evaluating design and roadmap choices, building investment cases, forecasting development and production costs, and supporting manufacturing and deployment at scale. You will give leadership a clear view of program economics, funding requirements, and risks as we build first-party compute capabilities. In this role, you will: Lead financial evaluation of custom silicon programs, including development investment, production economics, deployment assumptions, and expected returns. Assess first-party chips against alternative compute options. Build and own program-level models and multiyear forecasts that connect engineering milestones, development spending, manufacturing volumes, supplier commitments, and cash requirements. Partner closely with chip-design and engineering leaders on technical decisions that affect performance, power consumption, cost, and time to deployment. Translate complex design tradeoffs into clear financial recommendations. Develop a detailed view of chip and system costs, including wafers, manufacturing yields, packaging, memory, testing, and integration. Identify opportunities to improve economics as programs move from development into production. Partner with Supply Chain and Procurement on supplier strategy and commercial negotiations, including capacity reservations, volume commitments, prepayments, and contractual risk. Work with Treasury, Corporate Finance, Accounting, Tax, and Legal to evaluate financing and payment structures, manage financial exposure, and support program execution. Support commercial deployment and pricing decisions through analysis of unit economics, total cost of ownership, and the relationship between technical performance and economic value. Establish budgets, reporting, and financial controls that give engineering and finance leaders timely visibility into spending, commitments, milestones, and emerging risks. Build a small, high-performing team while remaining directly involved in the analysis. You might thrive in this role if you have: Prior experience leading finance for semiconductor or custom silicon programs. You have directly owned investment analysis, program budgets, and financial decisions across chip development and production. An undergraduate degree in a technical discipline, preferably electrical engineering or computer science. An MBA or equivalent business experience complements your technical foundation. 10+ years of experience across semiconductor finance, hardware finance, strategic finance, or related fields, with substantial responsibility for complex technical programs. Strong command of semiconductor economics, including development costs, manufacturing yields, packaging and memory costs, production ramps, and supplier commitments. Excellent financial modeling skills and the ability to independently build models, test technical and commercial assumptions, quantify uncertainty, and recommend a path forward. The technical credibility to work closely with chip designers and engineering leaders, understand their constraints, and evaluate tradeoffs across performance, power, cost, and timing. Experience supporting supplier negotiations, prepayments, and major investment commitments in partnership with supply chain and finance teams. A hands-on operating style, clear communication, and the judgment to introduce financial discipline while helping technical teams move quickly. You use technology and AI to improve analysis and decision-making. A strong track record of hiring, leading, and developing high-performing teams. We work across the B2B ecosystem, including software vendors, technology platforms, and services partners, to help them bring useful AI offerings to market and reach more business customers. Working closely with Sales, Product, and partner programs, we build channels and repeatable go-to-market approaches that expand customer choice and adoption of OpenAI’s models and products. About the Role As a B2B Ecosystem Partnerships Lead focused on Partner Growth, you will own the onboarding, activation, and growth of a partner portfolio across OpenAI’s expanding ecosystem programs, including marketplace and Sign in with ChatGPT. This is a hands-on individual contributor role centered on partner management, joint go-to-market execution, and commercial growth. Your portfolio may span ISVs, technology platforms,, and other B2B partners as opportunities evolve. You bring a generalist’s range across relationships, business analysis, deal execution, and operational problem solving. You will build repeatable ways to support a growing partner base and take on selected strategic partnerships. Own day-to-day relationships across your partner portfolio, tailoring engagement to partner needs and opportunity while using repeatable approaches to support a growing partner base. Develop practical business and account plans with partners and Sales, with clear use cases, target customers, owners, milestones, and adoption and commercial goals. Negotiate product and commercial agreements with Legal, Finance, and Product, and lead selected high-touch strategic opportunities in coordination with other partnership owners. Guide partners through program onboarding, technical evaluation, integration, and activation; coordinate enablement and resolve barriers to launch, sustained usage, and expansion. Execute co-selling, joint marketing, and marketplace opportunities with account teams; coordinate with cloud and other ecosystem partners where they help customers buy and deploy solutions. Experience managing and growing a portfolio of B2B partners or accounts, with measurable results in onboarding, adoption, retention, or commercial expansion. An understanding of B2B business models, partner channels, and how companies bring products and services to market. Strong business judgment and analytical skills: you can assess partner economics, prioritize a portfolio, and build repeatable processes that help more partners succeed. The team is responsible for forecasting renewal outcomes, identifying and addressing churn risk, and uncovering opportunities to expand GitLab adoption, while continuously improving processes and best practices that support predictable, sustainable growth. descriptionAr: Hi, I'm Jace Talamantes . I founded Ashby's Customer Education function in 2025 and now lead the team. I am excited to be hiring a Customer Education Program Manager, Live Learning! Regardless of tier or team size, every Ashby customer deserves content that meets them where they are — practical, accurate, and genuinely useful. That standard shapes everything we build, and it's what's driven the development of our growing Academy courses, webinar program, and playbook library. We have ambitions to expand both the depth of our content and the formats we deliver it in, and this hire is a meaningful part of getting there. As our first dedicated live-learning hire, you’ll help define what this program becomes and build the practices that make it work. Our Startup Customer Success and Recruiting Operations Consulting teams already run live sessions that customers value. You’ll lead how those experiences should come together, bring a point of view on where we should invest next, and define what great live learning at Ashby should feel like. This role needs both vision and execution. You’ll shape the direction and stay close to the work: planning the calendar, simplifying registration, developing a workshop with an expert, coaching presenters, and hosting selected sessions yourself. You should be as interested in getting next week’s session right as you are in imagining what the program could become over the next year. You’ll report to me and partner with Customer Success, Customer Education, and Marketing. There’s a foundation to build on and people to partner with, alongside plenty of room to set direction and drive the work. If you enjoy forming a point of view, turning it into something practical, and improving it as you learn, there’s a lot to make your own here. Build a program that supports multiple presenters rather than depending on you to teach every session. Own the live-learning recording library. Make useful sessions easy to find and learn from after the live event. Decide what to publish, how to organize it, and when to refresh or retire it. Partner with Academy operations on publishing and with presenters and CEPMs on accuracy, supporting resources, and opportunities to turn sessions into other learning formats. Make sessions easy to discover and join. Work with Marketing on the website experience, audience communications, packaging, and connections to broader programs. Give customers a clear way to find the right session and their next learning step. Measure and improve the program. Track registration, attendance, engagement, learner feedback, and operational effort. Define the product behavior each program is intended to support and work with partners to assess whether customers take action. Expand deliberately. Use customer needs and program evidence to recommend additional audiences and formats, including onboarding sessions, RecOps clinics, applied workshops, and customer spotlights. You’ll work with your manager to prioritize improvements and expand formats, balancing customer needs with presenter availability and operational capacity. descriptionAr: In 2026, we launched Computer, the defining product for the new era of agentic AI. Millions of people now use Perplexity to transform knowledge into action, and a growing share of them meet us first on their phone. The Growth team owns the product loops that help people discover, adopt, and build lasting habits around our most important AI experiences — and on mobile that means owning everything from the App Store listing to the first task a user finishes to the moment they upgrade. As an Android growth engineer at Perplexity, you'll work across the full mobile funnel — install, activation, onboarding, push and lifecycle messaging, conversion, retention, and in-app purchase moments — for Perplexity, Comet, and Computer on Android. Engineers are responsible for end-to-end projects: rebuilding onboarding as a series of experiments, wiring in-app purchase and paywall surfaces to our billing systems, shipping notification experiences people actually keep enabled, and turning ASO and deep-link work into measurable adoption. Growth at Perplexity goes beyond incremental funnel optimization. The team sits close to the core product — we translate behavioral signals, model outputs, and fast experimentation into durable product surfaces used across consumer and enterprise workflows. You'll move fast, run many experiments in parallel, and own the outcome end-to-end, while respecting the constraints mobile brings: release cycles, store review, and version fragmentation. Why Perplexity is different Craftsmanship. We build high quality, tasteful products targeting both the AI native and AI curious. Ownership. You identify the problem, design the solution and ship it. Entrepreneurship. We think like founders, act with urgency, and hustle to deliver for each other and our users. Scholarship. Work among highly talented peers, pursuing knowledge and truth, upleveling ourselves, our teams, and our products. Partnership. We amplify each others' strengths, break down silos, and give selflessly to help our colleagues deliver excellence. What you'll do Design, build, and own growth surfaces across the mobile funnel — install, activation, onboarding, lifecycle, conversion, retention, and paid upgrade moments — on Android. Lead experiments end-to-end, from hypothesis and instrumentation through implementation, analysis, and rollout, shipping many in parallel despite app release cadence. Build the flag-driven and server-driven patterns that let us test without waiting on a store release. Own in-app purchase and paywall surfaces: billing integrations, subscription and credit purchase flows, entitlement correctness, and pricing and packaging experiments. Build push and lifecycle notification experiences that earn their opt-in — permission prompts, targeting, timing, deep links back into the right task, and the instrumentation to prove they drive retention rather than churn. Make cross-platform surfaces feel native. Partner with web and design engineers so onboarding, upsells, and in-task nudges are consistent across web, iOS, and Android Partner with rest of Growth to optimize app store performance and attribution Hill-climb on the metrics that matter: install-to-activation, D1/D7/D30 retention, notification opt-in and engagement, paid conversion, and habit formation, instrumented with clean data and trustworthy experiment readouts. Partner closely with Product, Design, Data Science, Monetization, Marketing, and the core Mobile team to translate behavioral signals into durable product surfaces. Qualifications 3+ years of professional mobile engineering experience shipping consumer apps at meaningful scale on Android. Strong native skills — Kotlin/Jetpack Compose — and the willingness to flex into other parts of the stack to unblock yourself and others. Experience owning a full release cycle: build and release tooling, phased rollouts, store review, crash and regression monitoring, and rolling back safely. Strong execution: you ship many experiments and product improvements in parallel and drive them to a clear outcome. Familiarity with A/B testing and experimentation platforms (Eppo, Statsig, Optimizely, or in-house equivalents) especially inside a versioned app. Comfort data-informed decision-making — you can pull, segment, and interpret your own funnel data. Strong product judgment; you translate user behavior and growth opportunities into simple, effective technical solutions. Self-motivated with strong ownership instincts; you propose experiments, ship features ahead of schedule, and drive improvements without asking for permission. Genuine interest and adoption of AI products and willingness to learn quickly. Nice to have Direct experience on a growth or experimentation-heavy team Deep experience with in-app payments Experience with mobile attribution and measurement stacks (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch) and paid mobile acquisition. ASO experience, including store listing experiments and localized metadata. Comfort reaching into the backend or web stack to unblock yourself end-to-end. Time spent at a fast-growing startup or on a high-ownership engineering team.

descriptionAr: About Sentry Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building. Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future. About the Role Sentry helps developers identify and resolve issues in their applications. Behind our products is a complex foundation of distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and services that must perform reliably at scale. Our Platform and Infrastructure Engineering teams build and operate the systems that power Sentry. From cloud infrastructure, distributed storage, and real-time event processing to service reliability, scalability, and developer productivity, these teams provide the technical foundation that enables our products and engineering organization to grow. We're looking for Staff Software Engineers to tackle some of Sentry's most challenging infrastructure and distributed systems problems. Depending on your experience and interests, you might work on scaling our real-time event processing systems, improving the reliability and efficiency of our cloud infrastructure, or designing and building foundational services that support our products. In this role, you'll have the autonomy to identify important technical problems, lead solutions from design through production, and influence engineering decisions beyond your immediate team. We're looking for engineers who enjoy solving difficult problems, remain hands-on with the systems they build, and take pride in delivering meaningful technical impact. In This Role, You Will Design, build, and operate reliable, scalable distributed systems that support Sentry's products and engineering teams. Own technically complex projects from identifying problems and defining solutions through implementation, deployment, and production operations. Solve challenging engineering problems involving system architecture, performance, scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency. Make thoughtful architectural decisions, evaluating tradeoffs between performance, complexity, maintainability, and long-term scalability. Proactively identify technical challenges and opportunities for improvement, including problems without clearly defined requirements or established solutions. Stay hands-on with engineering, contributing production-quality code, reviewing designs, and helping resolve complex technical issues. Collaborate with engineers and technical leaders across teams to influence technical direction, establish engineering standards, and drive improvements. Share technical knowledge, mentor other engineers, and help strengthen engineering practices across the organization. You'll Love This Job If You Enjoy solving difficult technical problems where the solution isn't immediately obvious. Like designing and building systems that operate reliably at scale. Thrive on taking ownership of complex engineering challenges, from initial design through production. Balance hands-on engineering with technical leadership and enjoy influencing decisions without formal authority. Think critically about architectural tradeoffs and favor pragmatic, maintainable solutions over unnecessary complexity. Take initiative in identifying important problems rather than waiting for projects to be assigned. Enjoy collaborating with talented engineers, sharing knowledge, and raising the bar for engineering quality. Find satisfaction in shipping meaningful improvements and seeing the impact of your work in production. Qualifications 8+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong background in designing, building, and operating distributed systems or infrastructure. Strong software engineering fundamentals and proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, Go, Java, or a comparable language. Experience designing and implementing technically complex systems, with a track record of delivering meaningful engineering outcomes. Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure and services, such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. Demonstrated ability to independently own complex technical projects, navigate ambiguity, and drive solutions from design through production. Deep technical experience in one or more of the following areas: Cloud Infrastructure: Kubernetes, container orchestration, Terraform, infrastructure as code, networking, or service discovery. Distributed Systems: Distributed architectures, fault tolerance, consistency, replication, or high-availability systems. Data Infrastructure: Kafka, real-time streaming, distributed storage, OLAP/OLTP databases, or large-scale data processing. Infrastructure Reliability: Observability, performance optimization, capacity planning, incident response, or production operations. Developer Infrastructure: CI/CD systems, build and deployment infrastructure, developer environments, or internal developer platforms. Strong architectural judgment, with the ability to evaluate technical tradeoffs and design systems for reliability, performance, and long-term maintainability. Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly, collaborate effectively, and influence technical decisions across engineering teams. Experience improving engineering practices, sharing technical knowledge, or helping other engineers grow. We recognize that strong engineers come from different backgrounds. You don't need experience in every technology or domain listed above. We're interested in candidates who bring meaningful technical depth, strong engineering judgment, and a track record of solving challenging problems. descriptionAr: Hi, I’m Shane and I’m the VP of Finance & Ops at Ashby. We move fast and thoughtfully at Ashby, and we want buying to feel the same way. Too many companies build procurement processes that slow the business down in the name of saving a few dollars or eliminating outlier risks. We want a process that’s simple and fast by default yet intelligent enough to create friction where it’s needed and eliminate it where it’s not. That means building systems that route vendor decisions to the right stakeholders when risks call for it, and gets out of the way when it doesn’t. This role isn’t about becoming the single point of approval for every purchase, but rather it’s about designing the system and judgment that enables our company to move quickly on the small stuff while making sure complicated and higher-risk decisions get the input and oversight they deserve. This is an ownership role. You’ll operate with a significant amount of autonomy in shaping how procurement works at Ashby. Your initial responsibilities will include: Designing, implementing, and administering Ashby’s procurement process from the ground up: fast and frictionless by default, with intelligent escalation pathways that pull in IT, Legal, Security, Finance, and Founder review when the vendor, contract, or spend calls for it. Creating a clear, consolidated view of company-wide vendor spend. Tuning and administering our existing procurement tool, and evaluating replacement options as it comes up for renewal. Leading negotiation and contract structuring on our largest and most complex vendor relationships, either directly or in close partnership with the business leader who owns the relationship. Equipping business leaders with the tools and guardrails to own the vendor relationships that make sense for them to own directly. Partnering with IT, Legal, Security, and Finance to design the escalation process and ensure it’s working as intended. You should apply if: You have significant experience, primarily in procurement or vendor management with a high-growth tech environment. You’ve done this before, not just procurement, but procurement at a company that was really moving quickly. You think in systems. You’re as excited about designing a fast and efficient procurement process as you are about negotiating a critical contract. You have a bias towards speed and simplicity. You’re allergic to processes that slow everyone down to guard against a small number of edge cases. You’re comfortable with ambiguity and building the playbooks on your own. While we have a process and some structure in place, there is a lot of greenfield and you’ll need the confidence and perspective to build for the future. You take pride in getting the economics right on a deal but not at the risk of ruining an important vendor relationship. You have strong opinions on what good looks like. Whether it’s a review-routing framework or a vendor evaluation methodology, your views are rooted in principled thinking. Why you shouldn’t apply: You expect a mature, established process to step into. What exists today needs real tuning and reshaping, not just light maintenance. If you’d rather inherit a finished system than rebuild one, this won’t be the right fit. You treat negotiation as a win-at-all-costs game. Getting good economics matters, but not by squeezing a vendor so hard that the relationship is soured. Being on the other side of this isn’t pleasant and it’s important you are aligned with this. If your instinct is to optimize for the deal over the relationship, you’ll create problems that we’re trying to prevent. You want to be the approver for every purchase. If your instinct is to insert yourself into every buying decision rather than equip the company to move fast within the right guardrails, you’ll be fighting the design of this role. You need close oversight to know what to prioritize. You’ll be expected to identify which vendor relationships, contract negotiations, and process gaps deserve more attention. Your default is to treat every buying decision with the same level of scrutiny. If you can’t tell the difference between a contract that deserves a thorough review and one that should be automatic, you’ll either slow the business down or miss the risks that matter. You need a team to feel effective. This is an IC role for now and likely for a long time. Interview Plan: 30 min with Recruiting 45 min Hiring Manager Interview with Shane Take-home Assignment 45 min Take-Home Debrief with Shane Final Round (2.5 hours) Benefits Competitive salary and equity. 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby- do it when you feel financially comfortable. Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅. Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise. Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive! $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval. If you’re in the US, top-notch health insurance for you and your dependents with all premiums covered by us. Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply. We're in the talent acquisition software business. We run the end-to-end hiring process through our own platform, and ensure a level playing field for all candidates. Reaching out to hiring managers or recruiters directly won't improve your odds of success. Please focus your energy on the quality of your application.
