descriptionAr: About the Team OpenAI didn’t begin as a traditional company. It began as an idea: that artificial intelligence could be developed in a way that benefits everyone. As a creative team, our role is to help make sure the work behind that idea is understood, as it leaves the lab and meets the world. This company works at the frontier of intelligence. Like any frontier, it’s unfinished, constantly shifting, and still being explored. Our job is to stay close to that uncertainty and help shape how this story gets told, in a way that feels grounded and human. We do this through campaigns, launches, films, brand systems, and work that doesn’t fit neatly into any of those categories yet. This team is for people who want to help shape something from the beginning. This team is for people who are energized by ambiguity, intellectually curious, and excited to build something enduring from the beginning. About the Role As Content Studio Creative Lead, you will build and lead a centralized content studio that serves the broader creative team. You will be both a senior maker and a capability builder: creating timely, high-quality content while shaping the studio’s creative approach, talent network, and quality standards, in partnership with Production on the processes that support the work at scale. We’re looking for someone who can move fluidly between hands-on content creation and creative systems thinking. You will work closely with leaders, researchers, creative teams, and external partners to capture stories at the source and turn them into compelling work for web, social, and the broader OpenAI brand. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. Travel for production may be required. In this role, you will: Define the content studio’s creative vision, creative strategy, and measures of quality and effectiveness, and partner with Production on production workflows. Identify the right creative talent and partners across internal teams, freelancers, and agencies, working with Production to build the team and production approach around each project. Create reusable formats, playbooks, and standards that help teams produce strong work quickly across web, social, editorial, and brand channels. Partner with creative leads to prioritize requests and set the creative ambition and craft needs for each opportunity. Work with Production to make shared decisions on scope, budget, tradeoffs, and how to bring the work to life. You might thrive in this role if you: Have 10+ years of building or significantly scaling a content, production, editorial, or studio capability. Are an accomplished content maker with strong editorial judgment and a portfolio spanning multiple formats and channels. Can personally develop and create high-priority content with leaders, researchers, customers, and external partners, from concept through delivery. Can creatively lead work from concept through delivery while partnering with Production and remaining hands-on when the work demands it. Build trust quickly with senior leaders, technical experts, creative collaborators, and external talent. Bring operational rigor, resourcefulness, and calm decision-making to fast-moving production environments. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement . Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form . No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link . OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

Execute a multi-touch outreach cadence (call, email, social, etc.) to all prospects in your assigned territory using Outreach to maximize engagement and conversion rates. Manage, track, and accurately report all prospecting activities and pipeline in Salesforce to provide clear visibility into performance and forecast. Collaborate with Field, Corporate, and Digital Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to build targeted account lists, campaigns, and call strategies. Proven experience taking initiative, persisting through setbacks, and independently driving projects or activities through to successful outcomes. Proficiency in using Salesforce, Sales Navigator, and Outreach or similar prospecting and sequencing tools. The ability to travel for events such as trainings, team offsites, customer meetings, etc. Proficiency in English, our company language, is required for effective communication. About the team As part of GitLab's growing Sales team, you will work closely with the Field and Digital Marketing teams, as well as the Sales and Customer Success teams. Our BDRs come from diverse backgrounds, and we provide extensive onboarding and training so you have the DevOps and GitLab knowledge you need to succeed. descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations | Austin, TX | London, UK About the Role Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a massively successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization. R2 is Cloudflare's object storage platform, offering developers durable, reliable storage that integrates seamlessly with Cloudflare's global network and Developer Platform. The R2 Metadata team owns the metadata layer that underpins every R2 operation, every object put, get, list, and delete flows through the systems we build and operate. R2 is growing rapidly, and the metadata layer must evolve to keep pace. The team is responsible for designing and operating the metadata systems that track every object in R2, building and shipping developer-facing features, and ensuring the reliability and performance of these systems at global scale. You'll be joining a team that operates at the intersection of distributed databases, large scale storage infrastructure, and edge computing;  building systems that need to be correct, fast, and reliable. Responsibilities Design and implement features in a metadata system, backed by a distributed SQL DB,  that serves every R2 API operation, ensuring correctness, performance, and compatibility with the S3 API surface. Build and operate production services on Cloudflare Workers and Kubernetes that handle high throughput metadata operations with strong consistency and durability guarantees. Own the schema, data model, and query patterns for a metadata layer managing billions of objects across multiple distributed database clusters. Own projects end to end; from design docs and schema changes through implementation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring. Participate in oncall rotations, drive incident resolution, and write postmortems that improve reliability. Use AI tools extensively to accelerate development, debugging, and operational tasks. We expect engineers to leverage AI as a core part of their workflow. Collaborate across teams (storage infrastructure, networking, other platform teams) to coordinate capacity planning, API contracts, and cross cutting initiatives. Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience Strong programming skills in TypeScript, Go, or similar languages. Experience with distributed databases; schema design, query optimization, indexing strategies, and understanding consistency/performance tradeoffs at scale. Experience building or operating large scale distributed systems with strong reliability requirements. Familiarity with cloud infrastructure concepts such as object storage, edge computing, or service oriented architectures. Understanding of reliability and observability practices: monitoring, alerting, performance tuning, and incident response. Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain technical decisions clearly and coordinate across teams. Comfortable working with AI coding tools as part of a daily development workflow. Experience with Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, or edge computing platforms is a strong plus. What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost. descriptionAr: About the Role As a Financial Systems Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the financial systems and integrations that support critical accounting processes across Oracle Fusion Cloud and OpenAI’s broader finance technology ecosystem. You’ll partner with Corporate Accounting, Accounts Payable, Revenue Accounting, Supply Chain, Engineering, Data, Tax, and other cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and auditable solutions. This role requires deep Oracle Financials expertise, strong accounting process knowledge, and an engineering mindset. You will work across corporate accounting processes including equity, payroll, accruals, leases, mergers and acquisitions, intercompany, and close; transform Accounts Payable processes; and design solutions for complex supply chain accounting, cost accounting, ASC 606 revenue recognition, and compute and data-center accounting. You’ll help redefine how finance teams work by applying automation, AI, and agentic approaches to reduce manual effort, strengthen controls, and accelerate accounting and close processes. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: Own the solution design, delivery, and continuous improvement of Oracle Fusion Financials and connected finance platforms, acting as both a hands-on engineer and a trusted functional partner. Partner with Corporate Accounting to improve processes for equity, payroll, expense accruals, lease accounting, mergers and acquisitions, reconciliations, and the month-end and quarter-end close. Work with Accounts Payable to deliver transformation initiatives across invoice intake, validation, matching, approvals, accounting, payments, supplier experience, exception management, and operational reporting. Design accounting solutions for complex supply chain initiatives across procurement, receiving, inventory, Supply Chain Financial Orchestration, costing, intercompany flows, logistics, and the lifecycle from acquisition through sale. Apply strong cost-accounting knowledge to standard cost, landed cost, purchase price variance, inventory valuation, manufacturing and logistics costs, cost of goods sold, and related financial controls. Partner with Compute and Infrastructure Accounting to design systems solutions for data-center and compute operations, including asset capitalization, construction-in-progress, placed-in-service, depreciation, lease accounting, reconciliations, and close. Partner with Revenue Accounting, Supply Chain, and Engineering to architect scalable Oracle-integrated solutions for hardware and other complex or nonstandard revenue arrangements under ASC 606, translating contract terms and operational events into accounting rules, data flows, controls, reconciliations, and a timely revenue close. Translate complex accounting requirements and operational events into system architecture, accounting rules, data models, controls, test scenarios, and integrations with Oracle. Architect integrations between Oracle and upstream or downstream product, revenue, payroll, treasury, data, and operational systems using REST APIs, events, middleware, and governed data pipelines. Design and implement Oracle Financial Accounting Hub solutions from scratch for multiple upstream subledger applications, including event models, accounting rules, mappings, integrations, controls, reconciliations, and end-to-end traceability. Resolve complex intercompany accounting issues involving foreign exchange, balancing, reconciliations, netting, settlement, and multi-entity operations. Build AI-enabled and agentic finance solutions—including assistants, model context protocols, automated workflows, dynamic dashboards, and conversational access to enterprise data—to reduce manual work and improve decision-making. Create monitoring, exception handling, reconciliation, regression-testing, and control frameworks so automated processes remain reliable, auditable, and supportable during close. Triage critical production issues, lead root-cause analysis, and deliver permanent fixes that improve both system design and finance operations. You might thrive in this role if you have: 10+ years of experience in financial systems engineering, ERP, accounting technology, or solution architecture roles, with demonstrated ownership of complex finance transformation initiatives. 8+ years of hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Financials and experience with several of the following: General Ledger, Payables, Fixed Assets, Lease Accounting, Intercompany, Cash Management, Cost Accounting, and Financial Accounting Hub. Experience delivering at least two full-cycle Oracle Fusion implementations or comparably complex enterprise finance programs. Strong knowledge of corporate accounting processes, including equity, payroll, expense accruals, lease accounting, mergers and acquisitions, reconciliations, and financial close. Hands-on experience transforming Accounts Payable processes and integrating procurement, invoicing, tax, payments, suppliers, and reporting capabilities. Deep understanding of supply chain accounting, Supply Chain Financial Orchestration, inventory and cost accounting, standard and landed costs, purchase price variance, logistics costs, and cost of goods sold. Strong knowledge of ASC 606 and experience designing Oracle-integrated accounting solutions for hardware, supply chain, and other complex or nonstandard revenue arrangements in partnership with Revenue Accounting and Engineering teams. Experience implementing Oracle Financial Accounting Hub from initial design through production for multiple upstream subledger applications, including accounting rules, integrations, controls, and reconciliations. Location(s): USA  About the Role and What You’ll Do Cloudflare is looking for a leader to manage our Cloudflare One Go-to-Market (GTM) Specialist team across the United States, Canada, and Latin America. Cloudflare One unifies Zero Trust security and networking to protect users, devices, applications, and networks. As customers evolve toward agentic enterprises, it extends that security fabric to govern workforce AI usage, protect sensitive data, and secure access and connections involving AI agents. You will lead GTM Specialists who partner with account executives, sales leaders, and Solutions Engineering to drive discovery, sales strategy, and execution across customer segments—while account teams retain ownership of the broader customer relationship. Your responsibilities will include: Build and develop the team: Recruit and coach GTM Specialists, establish clear performance expectations, and strengthen discovery, business-value conversations, and commercial execution. Own AMER growth: Deliver against the Cloudflare One quota, build qualified pipeline, and drive new customer acquisition and expansion. Align coverage and resources with regional priorities. Shape opportunity strategy: Partner with account teams on customer discovery, executive alignment, competitive positioning, business cases, and close plans. Lead strategic customer engagements. Partner with Solutions Engineering: Establish shared priorities and align demonstrations and proofs of concept with customer success criteria and a clear purchase decision. Advance modernization and secure AI adoption: Develop repeatable plays for VPN replacement, secure Internet and SaaS access, data protection, email security, and network modernization. Help customers address emerging access, data protection, and governance requirements for AI and agentic workflows. Scale cross-functional execution: Align with Sales, Customer Success, channel partners, Marketing, and Product. Strengthen field readiness, share customer feedback, and support effective post-sales handoffs. Run a disciplined business: Establish pipeline inspection, forecasting, and deal-review practices that create shared visibility and accountability. Improve effectiveness through AI: Adopt or build tools for research, preparation, coaching, and opportunity inspection. Measure their impact while ensuring responsible use, data protection, and appropriate human review. A record of hiring and developing talent, improving team performance, and delivering against revenue quotas. Strong pipeline management, forecast discipline, resource prioritization, and commercial judgment. Experience leading an overlay organization or achieving results through a matrixed GTM model. Ability to influence without direct authority, build trusted account-team partnerships, and coach discovery, value-based selling, and complex enterprise execution. Customer and Market Expertise Strong understanding of SASE, Security Service Edge (SSE), Zero Trust, and security and network modernization. Familiarity with Zero Trust Network Access, Secure Web Gateway, CASB, Data Loss Prevention, browser isolation, email security, WAN connectivity, and firewall-as-a-service—and their customer use cases. Ability to connect AI adoption and agentic workflows to least-privilege access, data protection, visibility, and policy enforcement. Credibility with CISOs, CIOs, and senior security, networking, and IT leaders. Experience adapting GTM strategies across segments and markets; Americas experience is particularly valuable. AI Fluency and Operating Mindset Practical experience using AI to improve team productivity, execution quality, or customer engagement, with measurable results. Strong communication and organizational skills, an entrepreneurial mindset, and comfort bringing structure to a fast-moving environment. Willingness to travel across AMER for customers, team development, and business priorities. TRAVEL : 25% - 50%

descriptionAr: About the Team At OpenAI, we are dedicated to building safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) to benefit all of humanity. Our mission attracts the world’s top talent across research, engineering, product, policy, and operations. OpenAI’s Recruiting Operations (RecOps) team provides the systems, workflows, and data foundation that power hiring at OpenAI. Within RecOps, the Systems & Enablement function owns the recruiting technology ecosystem—ensuring our ATS, offer workflows, and connected tools are reliable, well-governed, and user-centric. About the Role We are seeking a Systems & Enablement Lead, Recruiting Operations to lead improvements across recruiting processes, systems, and enablement. You’ll identify recurring friction, define the underlying problem, and carry solutions from an initial test through implementation, adoption, and a repeatable operating process. You’ll partner with Recruiting leaders, People Systems, and hiring teams to translate hiring priorities into scalable processes and programs. You’ll align stakeholders on the most consequential problems, establish shared operating standards, and lead changes that improve recruiting effectiveness. Success means measurable improvements, sustained adoption, and clear ownership that enables teams to operate independently and adapt as hiring needs evolve. In this role, you will: Lead projects from discovery through adoption, managing scope, milestones, dependencies, and risks. Owning enablement for operational workflow changes, including documentation, training, office hours, and change communication. Supporting offer approval and other sensitive recruiting workflows through clear coordination, followthrough, and exception handling. Identifying recurring support themes and driving fixes through process changes, documentation improvements, automation, or handoff to People Systems. Partnering closely with recruiters, coordinators, People Systems, and cross functional stakeholders to improve workflow usability and reliability. Using data and operational signals to monitor service health, prioritize improvements, and reduce repeat work. Evaluating practical AI and automation opportunities that improve support quality, speed, and consistency without weakening controls. You might thrive in this role if you have: 5+ years of experience in recruiting operations, HR systems, people technology, or related roles. Hands-on experience administering an ATS (Ashby strongly preferred). Strong understanding of recruiting workflows, offers, and hiring data. Ability to balance detailed systems work with user support and enablement. Strong communication and stakeholder partnership skills. Comfort working in fast-moving, evolving environments. Highly detail-oriented, with strong operational discipline and a commitment to accuracy and consistency. Nice to Have: Experience supporting global or multi-entity hiring. Familiarity with compliance-sensitive or highly regulated workflows. Experience creating training and documentation for operational teams. Experience working with analytics or downstream HR systems. Workplace & Location This role is based in our San Francisco office and we aren’t considering remote applications at this time. We offer relocation support to new employees, and we use a hybrid work model: three days in the office per week with optional work from home on Thursdays and Fridays. Our open-plan offices have height-adjustable desks, conference rooms, phone booths, well-stocked kitchens full of snacks and drinks, three in-house prepared meals daily, a private outdoor space for working in the sun or socializing, nap rooms, private bike storage, and more. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement . Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. A high craft bar is imperative. You’ll be expected to pair exceptional interaction and visual design with deep product thinking—turning complex questions around safety, learning, and institutional needs into experiences that feel clear, trustworthy, and engaging. descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. About the Department Cloudflare's Network Engineering Team builds and runs the infrastructure that runs our software. The Engineering Team is split into two groups: one handles product development and the other handles operations. Product development covers both new features and functionality and scaling our existing software to meet the challenges of a massively growing customer base. The operations team handles one of the world's largest networks with data centers in 190 cities worldwide and a couple of large specialized data centers for internal needs. About the role Cloudflare operates a large global network spanning hundreds of cities (data centers). You will join a team of talented network automation engineers who are building software solutions to improve network resilience and reduce engineering operational toil. You will work on a range of tools, infrastructure and services - new and existing - with an aim to elegantly and efficiently solve problems and deliver practical, maintainable and scalable solutions. Leverage AI tools and automated assistants to streamline daily workflows. Examples Of Desirable Skills, Knowledge And Experience BA/BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience 3+ years of proven experience in developing software components for network automation. Understanding of software development principles, design patterns, and various programming languages (like python and golang) Proficient with modern Unix/Linux operating systems/distributions Experience in MySQL, Postgres, Clickhouse  (or equivalent SQL language) Experience with CI/CD, containers and/or virtualization Experience with Observability systems like prometheus, grafana (or equivalents) Demonstrated experience working alongside AI assistants or automated tools to augment task execution and project delivery Bonus Points: Knowledge of Networking engineering, with competencies in Layer 2 and Layer 3 protocols and vendor equipment: Cisco, Juniper, etc. Experience building and maintaining large distributed systems Experience managing internal and/or external customer requirements and expectations   Compensation Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary of €45,000-62,000.          What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license. descriptionAr: About the Team OpenAI's Compute organization builds and operates the infrastructure that powers frontier AI training and inference. Our data center engineering teams develop the technical standards and infrastructure required to deploy compute at unprecedented scale across both self-built and partner-operated environments. We work across civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, construction, and infrastructure delivery to develop data center designs that are reliable, scalable, and optimized for speed. About the Role We are seeking a Data Center Design Manager to coordinate the design and delivery of infrastructure for large-scale AI deployments. You will bring engineering disciplines and external design partners together to translate infrastructure requirements into coordinated, buildable design packages. You will manage design milestones, resolve cross-discipline interfaces, and keep technical decisions aligned with project requirements. Working with engineering, construction, commissioning, operations, and hardware teams, you will help preserve design intent from early planning through construction and turnover. The focus is design execution, technical coordination, and clear ownership of design decisions. Key Responsibilities Manage design scope, deliverables, milestones, and dependencies from concept development through detailed design and construction support. Coordinate civil, structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, controls, and physical network interfaces across data center buildings and campuses. Translate owner and hardware requirements into coordinated design criteria, working with discipline leads to resolve gaps and competing requirements. Lead multidisciplinary design reviews; track comments, decisions, technical risks, and actions through resolution before design release. Evaluate design changes with engineering and delivery partners, making impacts on reliability, safety, cost, schedule, and maintainability clear. Coordinate external architects, engineering consultants, developers, and equipment suppliers to maintain design quality and meet agreed deliverables. Partner with construction and commissioning teams on constructability, sequencing, RFIs, submittals, field issues, and design changes. Maintain design documentation and handoff requirements, and incorporate field and operational lessons into reusable standards and reference designs. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in engineering, architecture, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Experience managing multidisciplinary design for data centers, mission-critical facilities, or comparable complex infrastructure. Technical understanding of data center infrastructure and the interfaces among power, cooling, controls, structures, and physical networks. Experience taking coordinated design packages from early planning through detailed design and construction support. Experience coordinating external design consultants, engineering specialists, and construction partners. Ability to read technical drawings and specifications, identify interface gaps, and work with discipline experts to resolve them. Strong written and verbal communication, disciplined issue tracking, and sound judgment when balancing technical requirements with delivery constraints. Preferred Skills Experience with hyperscale data centers, high-density AI or HPC infrastructure, or other rapidly evolving mission-critical environments. Familiarity with liquid cooling, high-density power distribution, and the integration of changing compute hardware requirements into facility designs. Experience managing design reviews, quality checks, and technical change control across concurrent projects. Experience with modular or prefabricated infrastructure and design approaches that improve constructability and deployment speed. Familiarity with BIM, model coordination, clash detection, and engineering document-control tools. Experience supporting commissioning readiness, as-built documentation, and handoff to operations. Experience adapting reference designs and engineering standards to site-specific constraints across a portfolio. Professional engineering or architecture licensure, or relevant design and project management credentials. Build reference architectures, demo environments, competitive battlecards, PoV playbooks, and enablement content so account teams can handle more opportunities without your direct involvement. descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations Charlotte OR Raleigh, NC About the Role Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community. Senior AEs at Cloudflare sell into the most innovative companies in North America. In targeting high-growth, technologically advanced, and venture-backed companies, AEs are positioned to drive in-depth product discussions while communicating and demonstrating value quickly to customers.  This role within teh Territory focuses on both the acquisition of prospective Mid Market accounts, as well as the expansion of existing customer accounts.  The ideal candidate will have both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive customer engagement from technical professionals through to senior executive levels, and across Security, Network, Development and Infrastructure teams. Responsibilities Develop, execute, and maintain your territory plan to exceed quarterly sales targets and annual quota assignment. Be an expert in three unique sales motions; new business acquisition (new customer logos), customer expansion (upsell and cross sell Cloudflare solutions), and renewal within your territory. Build a robust sales pipeline utilizing the four sourcing funnels: AE led outbound, BDR, Channel, and Marketing Inbound. Develop and strategically leverage a deep technical understanding of the problems Cloudflare solves in order to drive a consultative sales motion. Craft and communicate compelling value propositions for Cloudflare services. Drive awareness through regular outbound campaigns on product and feature roadmap updates. Accurately forecast, build commercial outcomes by running a consistent sales process, including driving next step expectations and contract negotiations. As a trusted advisor, build long-term strategic relationships with key accounts, to ensure customer adoption, retention and expansion. Regularly evaluate usage trends and articulate value to show Cloudflare impact and provide strategic recommendations during business reviews. Network across different business units with each of your accounts, and multi-thread to identify and engage new divisional buyers. Position Cloudflare's platform in each of your target customers, including Cloudflare One and the Connectivity Cloud to realize our full potential in every customer. Operate internally as a liaison with cross-functional teams to share key customer feedback and insights to improve customer experience and further investments with Cloudflare. Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience 5+ years sales experience selling B2B SaaS Strong B2B discovery skills Candidates have a point of view of industry trends and able to customize a client centric why change narrative Track record of beating annual targets of $1M+ and successfully managing complex six figure deals Experienced in multithreading into the C-suite and across an organization to manage a complex sales cycle Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit Bachelor's degree required Software and system skills are a must (SFDC, Tableau, G-suite, MSFT suite) Ability to travel up to 25% of the time. Compensation Compensation may be adjusted depending on level and work location. For New York City, New Jersey, Washington, Washington DC, and California (excluding Bay Area) based hires: Estimated annual salary of $234,000 - $321,000 This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan. Equity This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. Intermediate Backend Engineer, Security Factory: Code Security An overview of this role As an Intermediate Backend Engineer on GitLab's Security Factory: Code Security team, you'll help developers find and fix security issues in the code they write and the open source components they depend on. Your work connects dependency analysis, vulnerability detection, and automated remediation. You'll build parsing that tells the security analysis engine which libraries and frameworks a project uses, extend a service that turns security advisories into dependency update merge requests, and develop hybrid analyzers that combine rule-based detection with artificial intelligence (AI) reasoning. You'll help evaluate how well those analyzers find real vulnerabilities and expand coverage of libraries, frameworks, and AI agent tooling. We use AI-assisted development tools in our daily work and expect you to use them effectively and with good judgment. What you’ll do Develop secure, well-tested, performant parsing for dependency manifests, lockfiles, and software bills of materials (SBOMs). Extend support for new package ecosystems and formats in the analysis engine and remediation service. Build and apply analyzers that combine deterministic analysis with AI-driven analysis, working with the team's technical leadership. Review their results and measure false positives and missed findings against benchmark applications with known vulnerabilities. Create detection rules mapped to Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) and the test fixtures that prove they work. Contribute to packaging analyzers for continuous integration (CI) jobs, AI agent workflows, and command-line tools, reporting findings in GitLab's standard security report formats. Extend the automated remediation service, from running dependency updates in a sandbox to opening merge requests. Solve technical problems of moderate scope and complexity. Identify technical debt that slows the team down, and propose and implement improvements. Write maintainable code that meets our internal standards, and help maintain those standards through code review. Participate in on-call rotations to troubleshoot product operations, security operations, and urgent engineering issues. What you’ll bring Experience using AI or large language model (LLM) tools to generate or evaluate technical content, with the judgment to know when output is trustworthy and when it isn't. Solid professional experience writing and testing production code in a systems language, particularly Go and/or Rust. We use both, plus Ruby for remediation and Python for some analyzers, and value a willingness to work across them. A willingness to learn how vulnerabilities arise in code and the software supply chain, explore common vulnerability classes such as the Open Worldwide Application Security Project (OWASP) Top 10 and CWE, and apply static analysis to detect them. Deep expertise isn't required, and we'll help you develop it. The ability to organize your work and follow through on tasks independently in a remote, largely asynchronous environment. The ability to communicate clearly and concisely about technical problems and propose iterative solutions. Helpful, but not required: experience with containerized workflows and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), or a willingness to learn them; package managers and dependency tooling such as npm, Maven, pip, Bundler, or Cargo; web or mobile frameworks; parsing, abstract syntax trees (ASTs), program analysis, or detection rules; or evaluating AI-driven detection against labeled data. We use Docker heavily. About the team The Security Factory: Code Security team builds GitLab's code-level security scanning capabilities, spanning static application security testing (SAST) and dependency scanning. We work closely with the Static Analysis team on GitLab's SAST engines, with Composition Analysis on the broader software supply chain, and with other groups across the Sec section. descriptionAr: Why Product Engineering at Langfuse Your work will have an outsized impact. Everything you build is open source (MIT-licensed) and immediately visible. Langfuse has 35,000+ GitHub stars and our SDKs are downloaded more than a hundred million times per month. When you ship a new feature the community notices in GitHub issues, on X, and in our community channels. Product engineers at Langfuse are the people who deliver new features end-to-end to our users. You own the product thinking from understanding the user problem to deciding what to build to shipping the solution. You will also have direct exposure to how cutting-edge LLM applications are built. The users you serve are some of the best and most ambitious software engineers leveraging Langfuse to improve their applications. Deeply understanding the problems they solve will help you design the best possible product and along the way makes you an expert on LLM engineering yourself. You will grow at Langfuse by Own features end-to-end : from talking to users, to writing the spec, to shipping the code and docs, to writing the changelog post with your name on it. To give you a sense: recent features a single engineer owned include the Langfuse for Agents release (new trace views, agent graphs, semantic span labels), the TypeScript SDK v4 rewrite on OpenTelemetry, and managing dashboards via API/CLI/MCP . Work across the full stack : and we mean full. Our surface area is wide: React frontend, Next.js backend, ClickHouse analytics, Python and TypeScript SDKs, public docs, Terraform modules, and more. You'll touch whatever the feature needs. One week you might be writing a new ClickHouse query for cost analytics, the next you're designing an SDK API, the next you're building a new rust worker for faster data processing. Talk to users constantly : jump on calls, respond in community channels, and route support requests. At Langfuse, support is how we build conviction about what to build next. Our handbook says it best: support by engineers is a core value proposition. Write public documentation about the features you own. At Langfuse, docs are product. Ship publicly during Launch Weeks : we've run four Launch Weeks so far, dropping a new feature every day for a week. Engineers present the features they built to the community. What we’re looking for Someone who has built features or even entire products from scratch end-to-end Experience building and shipping user-facing products end-to-end, ideally in TypeScript/React and with exposure to data-intensive backends Someone who can manage projects themselves. You know how to develop strong conviction about what to build and how to ship it. Taste for great developer experience: you care about API design, UI details, and clear documentation Interest in open source software and genuine excitement about talking to developers about their problems Thrives in a small, accountable team where your output is visible and matters CS or quantitative degree preferred Bonus points: Experience with ClickHouse, analytics databases, or building complex data visualizations Former founder or early startup experience Contributions to popular open source projects ML/AI background or familiarity with the LLM framework ecosystem No candidate checks all boxes. If you feel you are a good fit for this role, please go ahead and apply. Perks Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries. Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare. Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options. Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries. A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee. Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites. Culture - We All Shape It As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture. Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here . Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse. descriptionAr: Why Backend Engineering at Langfuse Your work will have an outsized impact. Langfuse ingests terabytes of AI tracing data per day. When a Fortune 50 company instruments their application with Langfuse, they hit the infrastructure you built. Everything you ship is open source and immediately visible. The core of your role is making Langfuse fast and affordable at scale: owning the ingestion pipeline, optimizing ClickHouse data models and queries so dashboards load instantly, and building the backend abstractions that let product engineers ship data-heavy features without reinventing the plumbing each time. You will also make sure Langfuse runs everywhere. You’ll operate Langfuse Cloud across multiple production environments, and make self-hosting effortless. You will support a single Docker Compose setup to enterprise-grade Helm chart deployment. You won’t be solving these problems alone. Langfuse is now part of ClickHouse, which means the people who built the database you’re optimizing are one channel away. Few backend roles give you that kind of access to the internals of your core datastore. You will grow at Langfuse by Own and optimize our ingestion pipeline : Langfuse ingests massive volumes of tracing data through a pipeline that flows from our API to ClickHouse. You'll work on throughput, latency, reliability, and cost efficiency at every stage of this pipeline. Make ClickHouse fast : our tracing data lives in ClickHouse. You'll design schemas, optimize merge strategies, tune batch inserts, write and review analytical queries that power dashboards and the UI. You'll become an expert on ClickHouse internals — and you'll have the ClickHouse database engineering team one channel away. Build new infrastructure-heavy features : things like LLM-as-a-Judge (where we post-process large volumes of ingested data asynchronously), alerting at scale, client-code execution, or batch dataset operations. Build the foundation and, if you like, dip your toes into the frontend for those. Test with real data in production : when evaluating a new ClickHouse schema, migration, or query optimization, you'll run load tests against production data to validate that changes actually improve things. We don't guess at performance. We prototype new table designs, run them in parallel on real traffic, and compare before committing. Scale for what's next : we're growing fast and new product directions like complex long-running agent observability and real-time evaluation push the infrastructure in new ways. You'll be thinking ahead about what breaks at 10x scale. descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Cloudflare sits in front of more than 20 percent of global Internet request traffic and terminates TLS for millions of domains. Every day, our network handles certificate operations across products like Universal SSL, SSL for SaaS, Origin CA, Cloudflare Access, and Cloudflare Tunnel. That scale has taught us how the WebPKI ecosystem works from the consuming side.  As certificate lifetimes shorten, agentic activity increases, and post-quantum certificates move toward production, the number of certificates the Internet depends on will grow dramatically.  Cloudflare is building a certificate authority for the whole Internet: a public, redundant, transparent CA that provides another trusted source of automated certificates and helps make the encrypted web more resilient. We intend to be ACME-first, automation-first, and transparent by design. We also intend to lead where the ecosystem is going, including post-quantum certificates and Merkle Tree Certificates, while continuing to support the classic WebPKI customers rely on today. As Principal Product Manager for Cloudflare's Certificate Authority business, you will define the product strategy, roadmap, customer experience, and commercial model for this new venture. You will work across product, engineering, security, compliance, legal, operations, sales, marketing, and the WebPKI ecosystem to turn Cloudflare's CA from a major technical commitment into a product customers trust and adopt. This is an early-days role on a growing team. It is not a role for someone who only manages backlog. The right person will be comfortable with high-consequence infrastructure, deep customer discovery, ecosystem trust, compliance scrutiny, and zero-to-one product building. The decisions you make in the first year will shape how Cloudflare participates in the certificate authority market for years to come. Responsibilities Define the product strategy for Cloudflare's CA business  across publicly trusted certificates, certificate lifecycle automation, ACME issuance, renewal workflows, revocation, Certificate Transparency, customer controls, developer experience, and integrations with Cloudflare's broader platform. Build for the whole Internet  by understanding the needs of developers, site owners, platform teams, SaaS providers, enterprise security teams, infrastructure operators, and partners who depend on certificates for availability, security, and compliance. Make resilience a product principle.  Help design product requirements that fail small, reduce customer blast radius, support automated recovery, and make certificate replacement fast enough to handle compliance issues, revocation events, or ecosystem incidents. Drive an ACME-first customer experience  that makes it easy for users of existing free or automated CAs to adopt Cloudflare with minimal tooling changes. Partner closely with engineering  on systems that manage certificate lifecycles, automate issuance and renewal, integrate with HSMs, protect keys, support auditability, and operate within strict reliability and correctness requirements. Partner with compliance, legal, security, and operations  to ensure product decisions align with CA/Browser Forum Baseline Requirements, WebTrust audits, root store program policies, Certificate Policy and Certification Practice Statement commitments, and public incident response expectations. Own go-to-market strategy  including packaging, pricing, launch sequencing, competitive positioning, customer segmentation, sales enablement, developer messaging, and adoption metrics. Help make Cloudflare Customer Zero  by ensuring our own usage of the CA exercises the product at Cloudflare scale and informs the roadmap before customers depend on it. descriptionAr: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role As the Regional Director, Sales for Germany, you’ll lead a high-performing team of Strategic & Major Account Executive professionals to grow adoption of GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You’ll be responsible for managing software sales, bookings, and revenue, while building strong relationships with new and existing customers who rely on GitLab to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, and reduce security and compliance risk. Reporting to the VP, Central EMEA, you’ll hire and develop top talent, set clear territory and industry strategies, and ensure your team’s sales plans align with GitLab’s overall growth goals in this market. In your first year, you’ll focus on building a strong team culture, deepening our presence with German clients, and consistently meeting or exceeding performance objectives in a fast-paced, open source software and SaaS environment. Responsibilities Lead, coach, and motivate a team of Strategic & Major Account Executives focused on the German market to deliver software sales, bookings, and revenue results Drive territory and industry planning by analyzing market dynamics, customer needs, and competitive trends to identify and execute on growth opportunities Develop and own accurate sales forecasts, territory management plans, and growth strategies that align to GitLab’s overall revenue goals Establish, track, and report on key performance metrics for the team, and take action to address gaps and improve outcomes Collaborate closely with Renewals, Marketing, and other cross-functional partners to manage pipeline health, renewal performance, and deal execution Recruit, hire, and onboard top sales talent while building and maintaining a strong pipeline of potential future hires in the region Create a high-performing, inclusive, and positive team culture through regular coaching, clear expectations, and ongoing development Educate and enable your team on GitLab’s product, pricing, AI-powered DevSecOps positioning, and key industry and regulatory factors relevant to the German market, such as data privacy, data sovereignty, and sector-specific compliance requirements Requirements Progressive experience in field sales and sales operations in an open source software, DevOps, or similar software-as-a-service environment Demonstrated success leading and developing account-focused sales teams, including hiring, coaching, and performance management Proven track record of meeting or exceeding performance objectives (revenue targets, pipeline targets, etc.) Experience building and executing go-to-market strategies for the German market, with a willingness to both lead and participate directly in selling activities Commercial and analytical skills to interpret sales performance data and adjust regional plans in ways that drive sustainable, long-term growth Practical experience working with CRM and sales/marketing tools (for example Salesforce, Clari, Marketo) to manage forecasts, territories, and pipeline Ability to analyze market trends, customer needs, and competitive dynamics to inform territory planning and team enablement Strong relationship-building, negotiation, and presentation skills, including executive-level written and verbal communication and the ability to mentor others Alignment with GitLab’s values and interest in open source, with openness to candidates who bring transferable leadership and regional sales experience from adjacent software markets   Remote-Global How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being Flexible Paid Time Off  Team Member Resource Groups Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan Growth and Development Fund Parental Leave   Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application. Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.   Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us. GitLab is proud to be an equal

descriptionAr: About the Team OpenAI’s B2B Marketing team helps businesses understand, adopt, and get value from our products. We work closely with Product, Research, Sales, and Communications to connect advances in AI to the problems organizations are trying to solve. About the Role We’re looking for a Messaging Lead to shape how businesses understand OpenAI and the value of our portfolio. You’ll develop a clear enterprise narrative, connect individual product stories to it, and help explain how AI is changing the way people and organizations work. You’ll work directly with senior leaders and technical teams to make difficult positioning decisions and turn them into work that customers, executives, and the field can use. You’ll be a hands-on writer and editor as well as a strategic partner, responsible for the quality and coherence of our most important business stories. This is a senior individual contributor role, with the potential to build and lead a team as the function grows. In this role, you will: Define and evolve the enterprise narrative and the messages that connect our products to customer needs and business outcomes. Partner with product and industry marketers to make the portfolio clear and differentiated while preserving the depth each audience needs. Translate complex capabilities into precise, compelling stories with Product and Research. Personally develop core enterprise pitches, executive narratives, major launch messages, and other high-priority materials. Bring customer insight, competitive context, and credible proof into the story with GTM and Customer Marketing. Help Marketing, Communications, and Enablement apply the narrative, and improve it through customer feedback and testing. Coach partners on messaging and writing, and help define how the function should grow. You might thrive in this role if you have: 14+ years of experience in B2B product marketing, positioning, or messaging, with a track record of shaping enterprise narratives and translating complex technology portfolios into clear, differentiated stories for business audiences. A track record of leading messaging, positioning, or product marketing for complex technology portfolios serving business customers. Exceptional writing and editing skills, with examples of work you personally created and an ability to explain the decisions behind it. Strong product and technical judgment, including the ability to distinguish a supported claim from an appealing assertion. Experience working with senior executives and technical leaders, resolving conflicting views, and leading without formal authority. Evidence that your narratives were adopted by customer-facing teams and improved customer understanding or evaluation. The willingness to work hands-on, move through ambiguity, and revise your view when evidence changes. Practical fluency with AI tools and thoughtful judgment about where human review matters. Experience developing marketers or building a messaging function is valuable. Previous people-management experience is not required for the initial IC role. Workplace & Location This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. Occasional travel will be required. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement . Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form . No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link . OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Lisbon | London | Hybrid About the Department Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a massively successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization. About the Team The Workers KV team delivers Cloudflare's global, low-latency, key-value data storage. KV lets developers store and retrieve data globally. With Workers KV, you can build dynamic and performant APIs and websites that support high read volumes with low latency. KV is integrated with Cloudflare Workers but can also be used via our REST API. Here are a few example use-cases: Caching API responses Storing user configurations and preferences Storing user authentication details The team is geographically distributed across Western Europe. What you'll do We are looking for an experienced Senior Engineering Manager to join our team. You will work with a team of passionate, talented engineers that are building innovative products that bring security and speed to millions of internet users each day. You will play an active part in shaping product features and improving performance to make Workers KV the best it can be. You will make sure our company hits our ambitious goals from an engineering standpoint. You will change the way people build applications. You bring a passion for meeting business needs by building technical, innovative solutions. You excel to understand how big-picture goals inform technical details. You thrive in a fast-paced iterative engineering environment and have experience in delivering scalable distributed systems. Most importantly, you have a track record of having past teams respect you as both a technical leader and manager. Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience Strong communications skills - especially building a shared understanding of systems among a team's members. Comfortable leading and hiring a team that builds distributed systems. Navigate uncertainty and ambiguity - many of the things we build have never been built before anywhere and you are expected to find a way to deliver. Excel at planning, creating teams, and overseeing execution to meet commitments and deliver with predictability Comfortable building developer-loved APIs that scale Demonstrate a track record of leading a team including hiring, on-boarding, and professional development. You inspire your team to reach higher. You’re as good as explaining “why” as you are “how”. Experience implementing tools, process, internal instrumentation, methodologies and resolving blockages At least 4 years of recent professional experience with TypeScript or Go. Solid understanding of computer science fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented or functional design. Deep understanding of the web and technologies such as web browsers, HTTP, JavaScript and WebAssembly Bonus Points Experience building high performance distributed systems Experience delivering and operating critical infrastructure for cloud platforms, especially serverless platforms Deep Linux/UNIX systems, kernel, or networking knowledge Contributions to large open source projects Experience working with distributed storage and cache architectures Experience debugging, optimizing and identifying failure modes in a large-scale Linux-based distributed system Compensation Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. Equity This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan. Benefits Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S. Health & Welfare Benefits Medical/Rx Insurance Dental Insurance Vision Insurance Flexible Spending Accounts Commuter Spending Accounts Fertility & Family Forming Benefits On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program Global Travel Medical
